def transform(grid):
    """Mirror the two-column input across its vertical axis, then stack the
    input rows in reverse, forward, reverse order."""
    rows = list(reversed(grid)) + [list(row) for row in grid] + list(reversed(grid))
    return [[row[1], row[0], row[0], row[1]] for row in rows]
